title: NZBGet matched benchmark JSONL row v1
$comment: Exactly one object per nonblank JSONL line. The strict parser rejects duplicate keys, NaN and infinity. Runtime validator enforces finite positive normalized latency, known required variants, unique case/variant/process/round, complete matched blocks, contiguous distinct order and equal observable digests. A whole missing variant produces HOLD; a selectively unmatched block is rejected. All raw rows and outliers are retained. Limits: 100000 rows, 128 processes per fixture, 4000000 total bootstrap cluster selections counting every variant history and ratio. Process identifiers assert independence; trusted collection must prove it.
